subject.title: fix(cron): expose flat cron job fields and normalize malformed tool args

question: Should the cron tool permanently advertise this broad flat field set—including provider-selection and sensitive payload controls—to every model, despite the added prompt budget?
rationale: The patch is additive and has credible proof, but the acceptable model-facing allowlist and prompt-budget tradeoff are product and security-boundary decisions rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the reviewed flat allowlist
options.body: Accept the current field set and prompt expansion, keeping the existing command/cwd and on-exit denials.

options.title: Narrow the advertised flat fields
options.body: Keep recovery support but expose only common safe scheduling and agent-turn fields, leaving sensitive controls nested or CLI/Gateway-only.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Keep the current nested contract until cron owners define a smaller model-facing schema and prompt-budget target.

recommendation.title: Narrow the advertised flat fields
recommendation.body: Keep recovery support but expose only common safe scheduling and agent-turn fields, leaving sensitive controls nested or CLI/Gateway-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete feature-history signal available is the related merged cron compatibility work.
